lines: Paints a stripe on the hull for every pilot grounded.
Flies with the cockpit lights off.
Won this ship in a card game and never paid the docking fee.
Hums the same three notes before every attack.
Once rammed a freighter just to make a point.
Keeps a dead houseplant on the dashboard for luck.
Has never lost a staring contest.
Refuses to fly on Tuesdays. Today is an exception.
Named the guns after old girlfriends and boyfriends.
Trained on salvage drones. Still talks to them.
Drinks engine coolant on a dare. Says it tastes like mint.
Was banned from three space stations for loud music.
Carries a photo of you, circled in red.
Holds the sector record for most near misses.
Signs every kill with a smiley face in the debris.
Learned to fly by stealing a mining tug at age twelve.
Owes money to half the pirates in the belt.
Thinks your ship looks cheap.
Still mad about the last time.
Wears the same flight suit for luck. It shows.
Once flew through a sun flare on purpose.
Collects the black boxes of beaten pilots.
Keeps a tally of your mistakes on a whiteboard.
Swears the ship is haunted. Likes it that way.
Taught the autopilot to curse.
Has a scar from every world on the map.
Shaved off one eyebrow after losing a bet. Kept it that way.
Thinks shields are for cowards. Has shields anyway.
Got kicked out of flight school for being too fast.
Paints flames on the nose cone every Sunday.
Reads your flight logs for fun.
Believes in exactly one thing: winning.
Lost a brother in the Ion Storm. Blames everyone.
Once fought a boss alone and called it a warm-up.
Has a cat on board named Torpedo.
Sends a postcard to every pilot before the fight.
Never uses the brakes. The ship doesn't have any.
Built the ship from three wrecks and a vending machine.
Laughs on the open channel during dogfights.
Refuses to eat anything that isn't in a tube.
Has a lucky wrench and nobody touches it.
Grew up on a scrap barge in the Debris Belt.
Wants your ship for spare parts.
Sold their wings to buy better guns.
Keeps a list. You are near the top.
Was the best pilot in the fleet until the fleet ran out of money.
Dreams about your engine signature.
Once outran a missile by turning the music up.
Has been grounded twelve times. Flew anyway.
Thinks the Void Citadel is overrated.
Polishes the cannons every morning.
Has a voice like gravel in a blender.
Never forgets a face. Or a hull number.
Started as a cargo runner. Got bored.
Flew straight through a minefield to win a bet.
Writes bad poetry about explosions.
Chews toothpicks. Spits them at the screen.
Speaks four languages. Swears in all of them.
Has a tattoo of their own ship.
Wakes up at 4 a.m. to practice barrel rolls.
Calls everyone "rookie," even the admirals.
Lost the left glove in a fight. Kept the right one.
Keeps the canopy scratched on purpose. Looks tougher.
Never takes the same route twice.
Was a bounty hunter once. Retired. Unretired.
Painted your call sign on a target dummy.
Believes the Harvester is a misunderstood creature.
Got their nickname from a bar fight nobody remembers.
Owns nothing but the ship and a grudge.
Once beat a rival by pretending to surrender.
Hates small talk. Loves loud engines.
Is always eating sunflower seeds.
Keeps a spare engine in the cargo hold, just in case.
Says the Ion Storm tickles.
Never misses the second shot.
Wants a rematch. Always wants a rematch.
Sleeps in the cockpit.
Once dated a station commander. It ended in a court-martial.
Flies like the fuel is free.
Has never read a manual.
Learned to dodge by playing dodgeball in zero-g.
Hand-painted every bolt on the hull.
Got lost in the Solar Foundry for a week. Came back meaner.
Smells like burnt wiring.
Plays chess with the ship's computer. Always loses.
Was promised a medal once. Still waiting.
Ties a ribbon to the antenna after every win.
Flies with the radio stuck on one station.
Has a pet theory about everything.
Calls the guns "the twins."
Was born on a moving ship and hates standing still.
Cut the fuel line once to make the ship lighter.
Thinks you got lucky last time.
Has never paid for a repair.
Once flew upside down for an entire world.
Keeps a jar of shell casings from every fight.
Writes your name on every missile.
Trains by fighting asteroids.
Prefers the debris field to the dance floor.
Thinks gravity is a suggestion.
Owns a ship older than most pilots.
Has a laugh that sets off proximity alarms.
Taught a parrot to say "target locked."
Gave up on a peaceful life after one boring week.
Swears the ship goes faster when it's angry.
Keeps the trophies in the cockpit, where they rattle.
Was a racer before the races got banned.
Wears mirrored goggles indoors.
Practices victory speeches in the mirror.
Ignores every traffic rule in the sector.
Once fixed the ship with gum and a prayer.
Doesn't believe in escape pods.
Flies best when the hull is on fire.
Has a rival. You are the rival.
Got the ship's name from a fortune cookie.
Holds grudges longer than the warranty.
Still owes the bank for the paint job.
Hums war songs from a war nobody remembers.
Was voted most likely to explode.
Has opinions about your loadout.
Turned down a job with the fleet. Twice.
Tunes the engines by ear.
Lost a tooth to a bad landing. Kept it as a charm.
Calls a missile hit "a love tap."
Brought snacks for the fight.
Owns forty-two identical jackets.
Navigates by the smell of ozone.
Thinks drones are just bullets that ask questions.
Got into piloting to impress someone. Kept going out of spite.
Can hear a beam charging from across the sector.
Saves the best moves for when someone is watching.
Never shuts up on the open channel.
Has stared down a Storm Carrier. Blinked first. Still mad.
Records every fight and watches them at half speed.
Was raised by mechanics. Talks like one.
Keeps a lucky coin that is definitely not lucky.
Will sell you a map, then hunt you on the route.
Once lost a fight to a vending machine.
Is building a museum of beaten ships.
Says "nice try" before every kill.
Sneezes every time the engines start.
Has a ship that's mostly duct tape and pride.
Knows every hiding spot in the Debris Belt.
Once took on four gunships with a broken cannon.
Speaks only in short sentences. Shoots in long bursts.
Keeps a spare helmet for the passenger they never have.
Thinks your Aegis is cheating.
Once slept through a boss fight. Won anyway.
Holds three speed records and one parking ticket.
Paints the ship a new color after every loss.
Drinks coffee strong enough to strip paint.
Learned evasion from dodging debt collectors.
Calls the Void Citadel "home sweet home."
Was famous once. Prefers infamous.
Fires a warning shot. Then another. Then all of them.
Can fix anything with a hammer.
Believes every fight is personal.
Never apologizes. Never explains.
Uses the same password for everything: "revenge."
Wants to see you try that move again.
Once flew blind for a whole world. Scored higher.
Has a ship that whistles when it turns.
Collects old flight manuals and burns them.
Owns a fleet of one.
Doesn't trust anyone who brakes.
Knows your ship's weak spot. Thinks so, anyway.
Earned a nickname that can't be said on the radio.
Was a farmer until the farm got bombed.
Plays loud music to drown out the warnings.
Sharpens the ship's antenna. Nobody knows why.
Started the fight before you got here.
Refuels only at stations that serve pie.
Once stole a boss's spare parts. The boss noticed.
Has a lucky shot and an unlucky temper.
Makes up rules for every dogfight and changes them halfway.
Thinks heat damage builds character.
Flies with a teddy bear strapped to the seat.
Was the quiet kid in flight school. Not anymore.
Lost a fortune on a bet against you.
Hangs your old wing panel on the cockpit wall.
Never fights fair. Never claimed to.
Practices aim on passing comets.
Built the targeting computer from a toaster.
Has a ship named after their grandmother.
Talks to the stars. The stars don't answer.
Keeps score on the inside of the canopy.
Thinks a tie is the same as losing.
Got rich, got bored, bought guns.
Is always five minutes early to a fight.
Once used a mine as a doorstop.
Has a soft spot for stray drones.
Sings off-key on the open channel.
Swore off fighting. Lasted a day.
Can't stand the sound of your engines.
Spends every Core on bigger cannons.
Wins arguments by being louder.
Has been called a menace by three governments.
Uses a flight stick from a museum.
Ate a whole cake after the last win.
Can parallel park a battleship.
Polishes the ship with a sock.
Has a rule: never fly sober. Means coffee.
Flew a cargo hauler through a war zone for fun.
Says the Crucible Engine owes them money.
Never takes off the gloves.
Was once mistaken for a boss. Took it as a compliment.
Has a ship that rattles like a tin can full of nails.
Writes a diary. Every entry is about you.
Got into a fistfight with a hologram.
Thinks Repair drones are for quitters.
Brings a thermos of soup to every dogfight.
Flies like there's a camera crew watching.
Can't whistle. Tries anyway.
Has a ship with seven cupholders and no seatbelt.
Spent a year alone in the belt. Came back strange.
Calls every enemy "sweetheart."
Keeps a spare grudge in the glovebox.
Was once a hero. Got tired of it.
Hates the color of your ship.
Uses a calculator to aim. Still hits.
Learned to fly from a video game.
Has never seen a sunset. Has seen many explosions.
Talks fast, shoots faster.
Swears the ship has feelings.
Lost a duel to a pilot who isn't you. Took it out on you.
Never sleeps more than four hours.
Has a fan club of exactly two people.
Lives on energy bars and spite.
Keeps the windshield wipers on in space.
Once crashed into a moon. The moon lost.
Fights better hungry.
Uses an old song as a battle cry.
Can repair a hull breach with chewing gum and good timing.
Waits at the edge of the map like a shark.
Laughs at beam warnings.
Never fires first. Fires most.
Was raised on a station with no windows.
Calls you "the one that got away."
Keeps a calendar marked with every fight.
Prefers missiles to small talk.
Has a ship that's been rebuilt so often it's a new ship.
Owns a whole drawer of medals from places that don't exist anymore.
Keeps the engines at full burn, always.
Sees the fight as a dance. Steps on toes.
Fixed the shield generator with a paperclip.
Once flew home with half a wing.
Has a nickname for every gun, bolt and screw.
Likes the smell of burning metal in the morning.
Won the ship back from a pirate in a pie-eating contest.
Mutters the odds before every fight. Ignores them.
Can tell your mood from your flight path.
Never fights on an empty stomach.
Was born during a meteor shower and acts like it.
Keeps a log of every ship that got away. It's short.
Thinks the Daily is too easy.
Practices on old wrecks in the Debris Belt.
Fights like the rent is due.
Has never once said please.
Retired twice. Bored both times.
Burns incense in the cockpit. The alarms hate it.
Owns a single good shirt for funerals and victories.
Builds model ships of every pilot beaten.
Talks to the targeting computer like an old friend.
Can quote the flight manual backward.
Keeps a framed picture of their first crash.
Has a nervous laugh and steady hands.
Swears they saw something in the Void. Won't say what.
Brings a guitar on every patrol.
Has a ship that only starts if you kick it.
Doesn't believe in luck. Carries three charms anyway.
Thinks every boss is just a big target.
Fought in a war that ended before they arrived.
Steals parts from the bosses after every fight.
Can hear you coming from two sectors away.
Painted teeth on the nose of the ship. Kids love it.
Swore an oath to beat you. Forgot why.
Flies with one hand and eats with the other.
Lost the ship once. Stole it back the same night.
Keeps all the receipts. Every single one.
Says the Solar Foundry is "cozy."
Was a stunt pilot for a movie nobody saw.
Ranks every pilot in the sector. You moved up.
Hates surprises. Loves causing them.
Has a crooked smile and a straight shot.
Says goodbye before every fight. Rarely means it.
Fixed the radio so it only plays one song.
Once dodged a beam by sneezing.
Keeps a list of famous last words. Wants to hear yours.
Has a ship with more guns than seats.
Dances in the cockpit after a kill.
Waits for you. Patiently. Every time.
Keeps a spare set of dice in the ejection seat.
Bought a second engine instead of a bed.
Says every hull is just a suggestion.
Once outflew a storm and then picked a fight with it.
Took the long way through a minefield to save five seconds.
Scratches a new notch into the throttle after every win.
Hums lullabies to the missiles before launch.
Has the coldest stare in the outer wrecks.
Will chase you across all four worlds.
